## B24 audit

**Scope and citations.** All citations refer to archive `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/replay_s1_r1_M_descendant--frozen_meta.tar.gz`, under member prefix `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/candidates/replay_s1_r1_M_descendant/frozen_meta/C1/`. The supplied records are selected records, not the entire archive; the cited character ranges are the supplied ranges.

**Detection versus hypothesis.** The teacher’s proposal reports three successful development executions and identifies claimed visual differences in perspective, foreground proportions, lighting and openings. It says revisions changed multiple camera, geometry and appearance variables together, so causes cannot be attributed. These are the teacher’s report, not independently observable image facts in this packet (`proposal_result.json` [0,15824), `diagnosis`). The diagnostic record instead documents passing structural, material and composite checks for selected group `bank_00`, while semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Its alternative explanations for an absent item—omission, overwrite, cropping, occlusion or low contrast—are hypotheses; isolation was not run (`diagnostic_observations.json` [0,6915), `initial_diagnoses`).

**Coverage, materials and connections.** The target-selection rule chooses the lexicographically first qualifying non-root EMPTY, not every semantic object. Its listed Box and Rod descendants passed prescribed operations: a copied-material blue shader edit preserved 1,263 checked non-target objects; a move preserved part relations within a reported maximum matrix delta of 2.384185791015625e-07 and preserved 1,217 checked non-target objects. Three render attempts completed. These are reported operation results, not proof of texture fidelity, all-object coverage or physical contact (`diagnostic_observations.json` [0,6915), `initial_diagnoses[0].probe_result`).

The dependency projection shows 64 of 1,308 objects; its empty observed shared-material peer list cannot certify the 1,244 omitted rows. AABB relations likewise cannot establish contact or collision. The record explicitly leaves support and completeness unknown, so neither the move pass nor owner membership proves a correct pose or support surface (`diagnostic_observations.json` [0,6915), `initial_diagnoses[0].observation.dependencies`).

**Proposed update, not demonstrated student behavior.** The pre-proposal meta plan was actually used and requested no probes; it prioritizes composite, structure and material review. Its code allocates new probes only with explicit budget/count evidence, and warns against causal conclusions from a single controlled delta (`meta_execution.json` [0,11985), `plan.probes`, `plan.regression_priorities`, `actually_used_for_proposal`; `meta.py` [0,11051), `plan`). The proposed reusable policy recommends semantic-owner inventories, unique include keys, descendant-based shader targeting and local material copies; owner-relative transforms and actual support surfaces; multi-depth camera anchors; and separating lighting/exposure from surface color. It keeps renderer settings fixed and treats anchor estimates as hypotheses (`policy.py` [0,13668), `GUIDANCE`). These are instructions, not evidence that a student followed them or that appearance improved.

**Technical failure versus quality and acceptance.** The policy defines a usable execution as `ok` plus an image and a non-null step; syntax errors, missing images and failed executions trigger recovery rather than visual critique. Successful steps may be retained with `DONE` or `SELECT`; later renders are not automatically judged better (`policy.py` [0,13668), `solve`, `_chosen`). The reported development executions succeeded, so the proposal does not establish a technical output failure there; the reported visual discrepancies are quality concerns, not measured causal diagnoses.

For functional acceptance, the supplied record says an expected but absent composite counts as failure, never N/A; the selected target’s three checks passed. That substantiates only the recorded structural/edit-operability results, not semantic completeness, support, pose or visual quality. No candidate acceptance decision or actual student trajectory executing the proposed policy is supplied. The proposal is explicitly `status: proposed`, says improvement is unverified and reports `M_changed: false`; no accepted update or downstream gain should be inferred (`diagnostic_observations.json` [0,6915), `initial_diagnoses[0].observation.functional`; `proposal_result.json` [0,15824), `scope`, `status`, `M_changed`).
